title: Proofroom Action Receipt
description: An open format for agent action receipts (1.1). Backwards compatible with 1.0; adds optional scope_version.

schema_version.description: Format version of this receipt document.

use_case_public_id.description: Public slug of the use case this action belongs to.

event_type.description: Type of evidence event that minted this receipt.

evidence_level.description: Exactly three levels. No further levels are defined in 1.1.

approval_status.description: Approval state for this action, or not_applicable.

timestamp.description: When the underlying action occurred or was recorded (ISO-8601).

event_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the sealed evidence event.

config_fingerprint.description: Opaque configuration fingerprint when declared; null if not declared.

scope_version.description: Scope commitment version in force when this receipt was minted. Authority is never re-graded when scope later changes.

links.description: Optional opaque lineage edges. to_ref_id must never contain content.

signature.description: Optional Ed25519 signature over the canonical structural fields (see specification). Presence of a signature does not evidence that the underlying action occurred.
